what: Per producing seat: the window (min_h..max_h, hours) a state it reports can plausibly move an MT5 price over, its decay half-life, the session it is released into, and `release`: its publication kind (weekly / event / observed / calendar), the timezone it publishes in and, when weekly, the weekday and local time. Read by libs/mining/source_horizon.py in the miner compiler's expand_axes: a chart outside the window is DEMOTED in queue order (never dropped). libs/mining/release_clock.py converts a weekly release DST-aware to broker time (NY+7); the compiler mints session-transfer cells (`release_gate`) for scheduled seats, and mt5desk/cell_modifiers keeps a signal only after the release (available_at <= decision_time) and while the state keeps >= 25% of its strength by decay_half_life_h. Declared priors, to be revised by measured decay; a row may override any horizon key. A seat absent here reads UNDECLARED, never INSIDE. kind=strategy marks a strategy record, whose horizon lives in its own params.
